rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; Form 4562 is filed per business and line 12 is the section 179 deduction this business takes: the project copies the per-business allowance sc.s179_allowed, the second the return-wide s179.line12, which the second's own note says stands in for the per-business allocation it could not find.
